MathJax vendor notice
=====================

- Package: `mathjax`
- Version: 3.2.2
- Upstream: [MathJax](https://www.mathjax.org/)
- npm package integrity: `sha512-Bt+SSVU8eBG27zChVewOicYs7Xsdt40qm4+UpHyX7k0/O9NliPc+x77k1/FEsPsjKPZGJvtRZM1vO+geW0OhGw==`
- Included files: `tex-mml-chtml.js`, 23 CHTML WOFF fonts, and the upstream Apache-2.0 licence

These files are served locally so a page cannot lose only part of its mathematical alphabet when a third-party font request fails.
